commitResults.messageTitle: renamed chatbot and modified initial code
Implement Level-4 task handling to Tangent
Add Level-5 exception handling to Tangent
Add Javadoc comments to methods in Tangent
Initialize array from text file data
Modify text file based on marking, unmarking and adding tasks
Add date/time interpretation functionality to Tangent
Extract console startup and input handling into Ui
commitResults.messageBody:
Move Tangent's banner, welcome message, divider presentation, and command trimming into a dedicated Ui class. This gives the application an explicit boundary for console interactions while preserving the existing command loop, task behavior, and output.

Record a Java 25 UI regression session covering task creation, persistence, marking, deletion, validation, listing, and exit behavior.

Move data-file setup, task-record deserialization, and task-record serialization from Tangent into a dedicated Storage class. Tangent now delegates loading and saving through one storage dependency, keeping file-system concerns separate from command handling.

Preserve existing file formats and error messages, and record a Java 25 UI regression session covering load, save, mark, delete, validation, list, and exit behavior.

Expand TaskList so it owns the in-memory task collection and provides the add, remove, access, size, and empty-check operations that Tangent needs. Copy loaded tasks into TaskList and pass a copy to Storage when persisting, so other classes no longer manipulate the backing collection directly.

Preserve command behavior and rollback handling, and record a Java 25 UI regression session covering task creation, persistence, marking, deletion, validation, listing, and exit behavior.

Move command recognition, task-number validation, task construction, and date/event validation from Tangent into a dedicated Parser class. Tangent now delegates input interpretation and focuses on coordinating UI, storage, and task-list operations.

Preserve validation messages and task behavior, and record a Java 25 UI regression session covering command parsing, persistence, mutations, invalid dates, listing, and exit behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Dispatch list and exit through Command objects
commitResults.messageBody:
Define a shared command execution contract with task-list, UI, and storage collaborators. Implement ListCommand and ExitCommand, then dispatch the list and bye actions from Tangent through those command objects while preserving the existing console output.

Update the remaining command skeletons to match the common contract and record a Java 25 UI regression session for the command-dispatch increment.

commitResults.messageTitle: Dispatch task status changes through Command objects
commitResults.messageBody:
Implement MarkCommand and UnmarkCommand with task-status updates, persistence, rollback on save failure, and user feedback. Delegate mark and unmark handling from Tangent to these command objects.

Correct unmark so it changes a completed task back to incomplete, and add a UI regression case that verifies the saved status reloads correctly.

Implement DeleteCommand with task removal, persistence, rollback on save failure, and deletion feedback. Delegate delete handling from Tangent to the command so the main loop no longer manages this mutation directly.

Record a Java 25 UI regression session covering task creation, status changes, deletion, validation, listing, exit, and reloaded unmark status.

Complete AddCommand so it adds a validated task, saves the task list, restores the list if saving fails, and displays the creation feedback. Delegate todo, deadline, and event handling from Tangent to this command object.

Record a Java 25 UI regression session covering creation, mutations, validation, listing, exit, and persisted unmark status.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse complete input into executable Command objects
commitResults.messageBody:
Make Parser convert each full user command into the matching concrete Command, including task-number and task-description validation. Refactor Tangent into an object with a run method that loads tasks, parses one command, executes it, and checks whether it exits.

Move error display into Ui and preserve the existing console behavior. Record a Java 25 UI regression session covering all command workflows.
